get.summary: Which sign-in options this server offers, for the sign-in screen.
Public build and dependency summary, used by the web status page.
The signed-in person, their active workspace and a CSRF token.

patch.summary: Change your name or which hand you use.

get.summary: The workspaces you belong to, with your role in each.

post.summary: Create a workspace. You become its owner and it becomes active.
Switch the session to another of your workspaces.

patch.summary: Rename the active workspace (admins and owners).

get.summary: Members of the active workspace and the invites still open.

patch.summary: Change someone’s role. Only owners can make or unmake owners.

delete.summary: Remove someone from the workspace. Their own access grants go too.

post.summary: Invite someone by email. With `resend`, sends the open invite again.

delete.summary: Withdraw an invite. Its link stops working.

get.summary: What an invite link offers, before signing in to accept it (the id is the link’s token).

post.summary: Join the workspace an invite is for. It becomes your active one.

get.summary: The collections you can see, with what you can do in each.

post.summary: Create a collection. You manage it; restricted ones start private.

delete.summary: Delete a collection (needs Manage access). Its files move to the trash, unfiled.

get.summary: Who can open a collection (admins and owners).

put.summary: Replace who can open a collection: restricted or open, and the grants (admins and owners).

get.summary: The audit log, newest first, filtered and paged (admins and owners).
The same entries as a CSV file (up to 10,000 rows). The export is logged.

post.summary: Fill the workspace with fictional sample content (owners): collections, memos and meetings. Loading it twice changes nothing; a workspace that loaded only the collections earlier gets the files.
Start an upload: creates the file and returns presigned part URLs.

get.summary: Resume an upload: what storage already holds, and fresh part URLs.

delete.summary: Cancel an upload: storage drops the parts and the file is removed.

post.summary: More presigned part URLs (up to 100 at a time).
Finish an upload: checks every part arrived, then queues processing.

get.summary: Files you can see: filter, search titles, page with the cursor.
One file, including from the trash.

patch.summary: Rename, move, tag, pin or relabel a file (needs Edit).

delete.summary: Move a file to the trash (restorable for 30 days).

post.summary: Bring a file back from the trash.

delete.summary: Delete a file for good: the original, transcript, chunks and embeddings.

post.summary: Process a failed file again from the start.

get.summary: A short-lived link to the original. `inline=true` opens it in place (the player).
A document’s text, page by page (once it’s Ready).
A recording’s transcript; `q` marks the lines that match.
A meeting’s notes: summary, decisions, action items, chapters.
Waveform peaks for the player (0–1 per slice of the recording).

put.summary: Remember where you stopped listening (Continue listening).

get.summary: Action items from the 20 most recent meetings you can open, newest first; yours marked.
Recordings you started and didn’t finish, most recent first (up to 10).
Live file status for this workspace (Server-Sent Events): `file` events as files upload, process, move or leave; `ready` when connected; `ping` every 25 s.
Search files, passages and meeting moments (hybrid, ranked).

post.summary: Write a note. It is indexed like a document and can be cited.

get.summary: A note’s text as written (Markdown), for reading and editing.

patch.summary: Edit a note’s title or text. The text is indexed again.

info.title: Sotto API
info.description: Private AI for your team’s memos and meetings. Sign-in lives at /api/auth (Better Auth); writes need the session cookie and the X-CSRF-Token from GET /api/v1/me.
